title: Working Deliberation Contract (Stage 3)
description: Request and response payload contracts for `sekha-cluster-tool deliberate`, dispatched to the Node 2 Working Memory Scratchpad (POST /api/v1/working/deliberate, :8083). The response object is emitted verbatim to stdout by the CLI. Property names mirror the compiled tool's JSON tags exactly and must never be anglicised.

SensoryChunk.description: A salient chunk forwarded from Stage 1 as grounding context.

CandidateAction.description: An uncommitted proposed action or tool invocation.

request.description: Payload dispatched to Node 2. Populated from the CLI flags --task (objective), --input (observation), and --context (long-term grounding).

objective.description: The reasoning goal for this step (CLI flag --task).

sensory_chunks.description: Salient chunks carried forward from Stage 1.

long_term_context.description: Grounding facts distilled from Stage 2 recall (CLI flag --context).

observation.description: New observation for this step (CLI flag --input).

max_tokens.description: Generation budget for the local SLM.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature for the local SLM.

response.description: The completed reasoning step returned by Node 2.

step_index.description: Zero-based position of this step in the trajectory.

thought.description: The deliberated reasoning for this step.

proposed_action.description: The action the scratchpad proposes next.

is_complete.description: True when the trajectory has reached a terminal conclusion.

candidate_actions.description: Uncommitted candidate actions produced this step.

prompt_eval_rate_tps.description: Prompt evaluation throughput in tokens per second.

generation_rate_tps.description: Generation throughput in tokens per second.

active_goal.description: The goal currently held in working memory.

trajectory_length.description: Number of steps accumulated in the trajectory.
